slides.title: Legacy Daemon vs. Revamped Cloud Service

left.label: Existing Design
left.title: C Unix Daemon
points: Trigger: Local Unix crontab polling loop
Database Coupling: Direct CT-Lib Sybase writes
Job State: Mixed configuration & queue on single table
Extensibility: Monolithic binary rebuild per change

right.label: Proposed Design
right.title: Microservice & Split Schemas
points: Trigger: Centralized scheduler trigger per lab
Database Coupling: Delegated to domain microservices
Job State: Normalized definition vs. operational request

cards.title: Event Backbone

slides.title: Adopt Event Sourcing for Order Pipeline

cards.label: Context
cards.title: Auditability Deficit
cards.body: Prior CRUD architecture lacked point-in-time state reconstruction for compliance.

cards.label: Decision
cards.title: Immutable Kafka Log
cards.body: Persist domain state as an ordered stream of immutable business events.

cards.label: Trade-off
cards.title: Eventual Consistency
cards.body: Read views require CQRS projection handlers with bounded lag monitoring.

cards.body: Append-only immutable SIEM streaming.

cards.title: Infrastructure as Code

cards.title: Active-Active Compute
cards.body: Dual-region deployment with automated DNS failover.

cards.title: Cost Allocation Model

cards.title: Infra Build
cards.body: Core network and cluster automation validation.

cards.title: Shadow Traffic
cards.body: Mirror 10% production read requests.

cards.title: Canary Release
cards.body: Progressive rollout to 25% tenant traffic.

cards.title: Full Cutover
cards.body: 100% traffic routed and legacy decommissioning.

left.title: Promotion Procedure
steps: Apply DDL migrations for new definition and request tables.
Disable legacy crontab triggers on on-premises daemons.
Deploy microservice containers and enable cloud scheduler.

right.title: Fallback Procedure
steps: Pause cloud scheduler and drain in-flight request queues.
Execute rollback script to reinstate legacy schema state.
